messages.author: 9f3796adb6e20432
messages.subject: [aroma.affymetrix] Error Occured When Convertting CDF File
parts:
Hi:

I am running convertCdf() with R 2.9.0 on my PC / Windows XP. I am
going to convert HuEx-1_0-st-v2.cdf to binary format from ASCII
format. But an error has occurred noted as "unable to allocate vectors
of 10.9 MB" ( I have translated the error message from Chinese). The
memory is about 2G. Is that the point or some other reasons? Thanks in
advance.

Xinjun

messages.author: 1ff63ac4948de366
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Error Occured When Convertting CDF File
parts:
Hi Xinjun.

First off, you might be able to make use of the binary CDF files already
created (unless you are doing something non-standard). See:

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/huex-1-0-st-v2

As to your problem below, I'm not sure of the memory fingerprint for doing
the conversion, but I'd be surprised if it was >2GB. Perhaps you have
objects in memory in your current workspace? Do you still get the error
from a fresh R session?

As always, when you get an error, it is good practice to give the output
of both sessionInfo() and traceback() ... and even a code example wouldn't
hurt.

Hope that helps.
Mark

messages.author: 43e2e19dd6bd2992
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: Error Occured When Convertting CDF File
parts:
Hi Xinjun,

I don't know about the specifics, but the error message regarding 24.4MB
doesn't have anything to do about your total memory. What it means is
that you don't have enough memory *left* to allocate 24.4MB -- meaning
it's already being used up with other processes involved in convertCdf.
Changing memory options in R won't change this -- I think it takes as
default the largest amount anyway.

That is a very large cdf you are trying to convert, comparatively,
because it has information on all the probes (unlike cdfs that have only
information on certain annotated genes, etc.). Basically all that has to
be held in memory at some level. I haven't done it in a while, but my
memory is from past users comments is that you will probably need a
large amount of memory (e.g. much more than 2GB -- 16GB will definitely
work, I don't know about smaller). Or download a version from online
that's already been converted -- I think there might be one on the
aroma.affymetrix page somewhere.

Best,
Elizabeth

messages.author: 9f3796adb6e20432
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: Error Occured When Convertting CDF File
parts:
Hi Elizabeth:

Thanks for your suggestions. I have fixed the problem and some similar problems of "failed to allocate vector of size XXX". This problem is caused by the insufficient memory size which is assigned to  R by OS. The max size to R in windows 32 bit environment is 2470Mb.  When it is used up, the error occurred. After I have swathed to windows 64-bit where R gets much larger memory size, the problem has gone.

Xinjun
